Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made the first critical error at Step 4 (the initial thought after the first WebSurfer response) by prematurely inserting an "EDUCATED GUESS" into the fact sheet stating that "Ethan Zohn may be the winner born in May." This was a hallucination and a factual error introduced by the Orchestrator before any actual data verification was completed. The Orchestrator then instructed the team to "Continue focusing on credible sources... These pages contain substantial information on Survivor winners but require further detailed exploration," effectively biasing the search towards confirming this incorrect guess. This led the entire team to focus on verifying Ethan Zohn rather than systematically checking all winners' birthdates, which ultimately resulted in the wrong final answer. The mistake was not in failing to find data, but in inventing data (the guess) and steering the investigation to confirm a false premise.
